verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Stagehand as an SDK (TypeScript, Python, Go) that drives a browser you launch yourself: on Browserbase, locally, or attached over CDP. It also offers MCP/stdio tool integrations. Nothing documents a hosted HTTP endpoint for submitting a task and getting results back by polling or webhook. Browserbase-hosted browsers and server-side caching are adjacent features, not a task-submission API, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can submit a browser task over a hosted HTTP API and receive the result by polling or webhook, without managing any browser myself
